decision.decision: Keep exact exponent-mask QK default-off and outside the retained stack. Preserve the correct opt-in route and broaden investigation to larger correction/GDN costs.
decision.rationale: Both same-DLL runs pass every original prompt/output token, first logit and actual callback. Enabled runs all10 attention layers and reduces observed TTFT by100.8645ms, from27552.9067 to27452.0422ms. This single pair does not establish a repeatable whole-product improvement; both remain far above10000ms. Component savings do not transfer quantitatively to product TTFT.
